theater: 河南蔡州城與汝水兩岸

battle.name: 蔡州之戰
battle.theater: 河南蔡州城與汝水兩岸
battle.brief: 金哀宗自汴京退保蔡州，蒙古軍1233年秋冬合圍汝水兩岸，築柴潭、白坡兩壘斷其糧道與汲水，砲陣壓制城頭並以雲梯穴地強攻。守軍以十字弩、拒馬倚城死守，糧盡援絕，1234年初城破，金朝隨之覆亡。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰一方是金朝，另一方是大蒙古國。金朝為女真族建立的政權，與南宋以淮水南北分界，1232年汴京失陷後失去中原，只剩蔡州等河南最後幾座城作為根據地。蔡州原是金南京留守司治所，設行省、統軍司與總兵衙門，城中守軍主力為改編自河南義軍的忠孝軍，由統制崔清率領，另有南京各衙門的宿衛軍、城防民兵與隨軍家屬。金廷自汴京出逃時大批軍官、府吏與輜重同行，抵蔡之後以哀宗為核心重建指揮體系，軍令由帥府直達各營。蒙古一方以大汗窩闊台為最高統帥，於河南戰線投入蒙古本部騎兵、被征服地區的漢軍，以及徵發來的河南新附軍戶與隨軍工匠。蒙古沒有常設的攻城工程兵種，造砲、掘地道、架雲梯全靠漢籍將領與工匠手上的技藝，所以攻城器械數量龐多而工藝參差。蔡州之役是蒙古滅金的最後一役，雙方都沒有外援介入，南宋隔淮自保，未能出兵北上。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Jin dynasty and the Mongol Empire. The Jin, founded by the Jurchen people, faced the Southern Song across the Huai River; after the fall of Bianjing (Kaifeng) in 1232 it had lost the Central Plain and held only a handful of cities in Henan, with Caizhou as the last of them. Caizhou had been the seat of the Jin Nanjing Liushou Si, the provincial commandery of the southern capital, and carried an administrative palace, a military commission and a commander's yamen. The core of the garrison was the Zhongxiao Army, a force raised from Henan militia and then regularised, commanded by the inspector Cui Qing, supplemented by palace guards from the several yamen of Nanjing, town militia and camp followers. When the court fled Bianjing a large body of officers, clerks and baggage came with it, and the command system was rebuilt around Emperor Aizong once the host reached Caizhou, orders running straight from the commander-in-chief's tent to each camp. On the Mongol side the supreme commander was the Great Khan Ogedei. The Henan front drew on Mongol native cavalry, Han Chinese troops recruited from conquered territory, and conscripted Henan households together with the craftsmen and engineers who followed the army. The Mongols had no standing corps of siege engineers: cannon founding, sapping and the raising of scaling ladders all depended on the skills of Han Chinese officers and artisans, so the siege train was enormous in number but uneven in quality. Caizhou was the last battle of the Jin's destruction; neither side received outside aid, and the Southern Song, preoccupied with its own defence in Jingxiang and the Two Huai, sent no help northward.
people: 金哀宗完顏守緒是這場戰役的落難君主。他在1213年與宣宗兄澤王完顏承裕爭立，即位後對蒙古的處置一變再變：先議和南宋聯手抗蒙，後又中止北伐，和議破裂，終至與宋交兵。1231年拖雷率蒙軍假道宋境南下，會同河東、漠北兩路大軍三面夾擊，鈞州被圍逾月而陷，哀宗夜開城門逃出，經歸德轉入蔡州，1233年初抵達。右丞相完顏承麟原是西面總管，哀宗在城破前夕把帝位傳給他，他即位當日即死於亂軍，在位不足一日。忠孝軍統制崔清是城中最堅決的守將，1234年初城破時率所部在街巷力戰，兵盡而歿。蒙古方面，睿宗拖雷於1232年秋病逝於回師途中，窩闊台汗派察合台、闊里吉等分道經略河南，攻城大軍在蔡州會師；後續援兵與攻城器械亦由窩闊台下令自大都、河東兩路調發。南宋此時忙於荊襄與兩淮防務，只能坐看金朝覆亡。
peopleEn: Emperor Aizong of Jin, Wanyan Shouxu, was the ruined ruler at the centre of this campaign. He had seized the throne in 1213 in a struggle with his elder half-brother Prince Ze, Wanyan Chengyu, and his handling of the Mongols changed repeatedly: first a negotiated peace with the Song in the hope of a joint front against the Mongols, then the abandonment of the northern offensive, the collapse of that peace, and finally open war with the Song. In 1231 Tolui led the Mongol army south through Song territory and, with the armies from Hedong and from the steppe, formed a three-pronged pincer; Junchou was invested for more than a month and fell, and Aizong escaped by night gate, travelled through Guidai and turned south to Caizhou, arriving in early 1233. The right chancellor Wanyan Chenglin had been the western commander in chief; on the eve of the breach Aizong passed the throne to him, and he was killed in the rout on the very day of his accession, ruling for less than a day. Cui Qing, inspector of the Zhongxiao Army, was the most resolute of the defenders, and when the city fell in early 1234 he led his men in a street fight to the end and fell with them. On the Mongol side the Prince Regent Tolui died of illness on his return march in the autumn of 1232; Ogedei Khan sent Chagatai, Kuoliji and other commanders to operate separately across Henan, and the besieging host was assembled before Caizhou. Reinforcements and siege materiel were ordered up by Ogedei from Dadu and from Hedong. The Southern Song at that moment was fully occupied with Jingxiang and the Two Huai, and could only look on as the Jin was destroyed.
kits: 本卡兵器是十字弩。十一世紀初它已定型，屬弩類中以機括弩弦、武裝好後再上弦的構造：弩手不必像弓手那樣張弦拉滿，可藉腰腿之力把弦壓入機括，隨後放手待發。在蔡州之役中，它是守城一方的高精度壓制兵器。城頭的弩機架在垛口後方，射手俯身即可瞄準，數十步內完成擊發；弩矢帶粗重箭鏃，能射穿壘木、篷布與輕甲，專打壘內射手的頭盔與肩臂，使對方的雲梯隊在牆下抬不起頭。蒙古攻城序列中，弩的份量遠不如石砲。他們倚重配重式拋石機，即當時記載中的石砲或回回砲，以石彈壓制城頭、轟開壘牆，再以雲梯、撞竿和穴地同時施壓；蒙古本部騎兵用弓，蒙古弓輕而射速快，箭袋以每兵數十支計，遠射靠齊射覆蓋。守軍的火力則以弓箭為主、弩為輔，金地所造箭矢中有浸毒者，遇創即潰。攻城器械全靠牛馬拖曳，砲車與雲梯的組裝、轉運都消耗大量牲畜與工匠，蒙古並未建立專門的攻城工程兵，這一環正是靠漢人降將與隨軍工匠補上。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the crossbow. By the early eleventh century its form was settled: a bow strung with a mechanism, cocked after the bolt was laid, so that the shooter did not have to hold a full draw as an archer did but could slip the string into the nut with the strength of the legs and waist and then release on the trigger. At Caizhou it was the high-precision arm of the defenders. The crossbow locks were set up behind the crenellations, where a shooter could crouch, aim and loose within a few dozen paces; the bolts carried heavy heads that punched through palisades, canvas and light armour, and they were aimed at the helmets and shoulders of the enemy's archers inside the works, so that the ladder parties could not raise their heads at the foot of the wall. In the Mongol assault the crossbow counted for far less than the stone catapult. The Mongols relied on the counterweight trebuchet, the stone catapult or the Huihui pao of the records, to pound the parapets and breach the screens of the works, and then pressed with scaling ladders, battering rams and sapping all at once. The native Mongol horse used the bow, light and fast, each rider carrying several dozen arrows, and delivered massed volleys at long range. The defenders' fire was arrows first and crossbows second, and the Jin were said to poison some of their shafts so that wounds festered. Every piece of siege equipment was hauled by oxen and horses, and assembling and shifting the catapults and ladders consumed a great many animals and artisans. The Mongols had no dedicated engineer corps, and that gap was filled by Han Chinese officers who had come over to them and by the craftsmen who followed the army.
tactics: 蒙古在蔡州走的是圍城困斃的路子。遠軍抵近後不急於強攻，而在汝水兩岸及城東南築柴潭、白坡兩座壘營，環繞城郭形成包圍，藉壘牆遮蔽己方弓箭手，同時切斷城內汲水與樵採通道。砲陣架在壘後，居高臨下覆射城頭；雲梯隊與穴地隊分頭準備，待砲火把城頭守兵壓得抬不起身時再一齊動作。城東南挖掘的聲息一旦被守軍察覺，守方就以夜襲出城反制，燒毀一段壘牆與器械，使蒙軍的進攻節節延後。守方的部署集中在城牆與幾座內城樓上，重點是保住城門與城樓之間的通道不被截斷。城頭以拒馬、木柵分隔射界，弩手與弓手交替掩蔽；蒙軍雲梯靠牆，先以矢石砸梯，再以火攻與長杆推倒，附梯的兵常在半途被弩箭射落。糧道斷絕後，守軍靠城內窖藏殘糧、掘地取根與採集榆皮草根維生，軍中飢疲，逃亡與夜遁的事例不斷，巡邏與更番因此難以維持。城破之日，蒙軍自東面缺口突入，巷戰自街口延續到每一條巷弄，忠孝軍逐巷抵抗，蒙軍以火攻與弓弩交替封閉街口，雙方逐屋逐街爭奪，直至守軍耗盡。
tacticsEn: The Mongols fought at Caizhou by the method of starving the garrison. Instead of assaulting at once they built two entrenched camps, the Chaitan and the Baipo, on both banks of the Ru River and to the south-east of the city, so as to ring the walls, screen their own archers behind the works, and cut the city's access to water and firewood. The catapults stood behind the works and shelled the parapet from above; ladder parties and sappers prepared separately, waiting for the artillery to pin the defenders down before moving together. Once the digging was detected to the south-east, the garrison answered with night sorties from the gate, burning a stretch of the screens and of the equipment, and so delaying the Mongol timetable again and again. The defence was concentrated on the walls and on the inner towers, the object being to keep the routes between the gates and the towers open. The parapet was divided by chevaux-de-frise and timber fences, crossbowmen and archers taking turns under cover. When a ladder was set against the wall the defenders first shattered it with stones and arrows, then burned it and shoved it away with long poles, and the men still clinging to it were commonly picked off by crossbow bolts before they could gain the top. Once the supply line was cut, the garrison lived on what remained in the city granaries, on roots dug from the ground and on elm bark and other wild greens; the troops were hungry and exhausted, desertion and night flight were constant, and the watch and the rotation could barely be kept up. On the day the city fell the Mongols forced their way in at the eastern breach and the street fighting ran on from the gateways into every lane, the Zhongxiao Army holding lane by lane, while the Mongols sealed the streets with fire and with bow and crossbow fire, the two sides fighting house by house until the defenders were used up.
data: 蔡州在圍城之前接納了自汴京退下來的金朝官軍與大批輜重，史料以數十萬之眾形容遷入之眾，圍城初期城內軍民合計仍在數萬以上，忠孝軍等主力部隊為數萬之眾；到圍城後期，糧秣耗盡、逃亡與減員使可戰之兵大幅下降，具體名額史無明文，不宜斷言。蒙古方面在蔡州會師的兵馬以數萬計，其中真正投入步攻堅城的攻城序列只佔一部分，絕大多數是負責包抄斷糧與野戰的騎兵。史料另記蒙古在攻城期間造石砲數十座，並備雲梯、撞竿與穴地之屬，數目大致相應規模但無確帳。時間上，蒙古合圍蔡州的工程在1233年秋冬鋪開，總攻在1233年12月發動，1234年初中城陷，圍城到城破約三至四個月。弩的性能是這一戰值得記下的數字：弩的有效射程一般在一百五十至二百米上下，裝填完弦到擊發往往要數十秒，因此弩手不可能像弓手那樣連珠速射，城頭的用法是分段布防、齊射覆蓋一段城牆，再以弓箭補射換手。攻城方把雲梯推上牆頭到登城成功，時間窗口往往不到一分鐘。蔡州距汴京約二百公里，援軍若自中原調集，抵達之前城防已先崩。城破後，金朝宗室與文武官屬數十人被押解北上，府庫糧械盡為蒙古軍所取，汝寧一帶州縣隨即歸附蒙古。
dataEn: Before the siege closed, Caizhou had taken in the Jin army and the bulk of the baggage that came down from Bianjing; the sources describe the incoming host in terms of hundreds of thousands, and in the early weeks of the siege the population and troops inside the city still numbered in the tens of thousands, the main bodies such as the Zhongxiao Army running to several tens of thousands of men. Later, as the food ran out and men deserted or were lost, the number of those still able to fight fell steeply; no reliable figure survives, and it would be wrong to assert one. The Mongol force assembled before Caizhou was counted in tens of thousands, but only part of it was committed to the siege infantry; the great majority were cavalry whose business was to turn the flanks, cut the roads and fight in the open. The records state that the Mongols cast several tens of stone catapults during the siege and had scaling ladders, battering rams and sapping tools in addition, the numbers broadly matching the scale of the operation though no exact account survives. As to time: the works that enclosed Caizhou were raised through the autumn and winter of 1233, the general assault came in December 1233, and the city was taken in the first months of 1234, so the siege lasted roughly three to four months. The performance of the crossbow is worth recording in figures: its effective range was generally in the region of one hundred and fifty to two hundred metres, and cocking the nut and loosing the bolt took tens of seconds, so no crossbowman could fire at the archer's rate of shot. On the walls the weapon was used in sections, volleying to cover one stretch of parapet while archers covered the rest and changed places. For the attacker, the time between setting a ladder against the wall and a man reaching the top was often less than a minute. Caizhou lies about two hundred kilometres from Bianjing, so any relief force marching out of the Central Plain would have arrived only after the defences had already failed. After the fall, some dozens of members of the Jin royal house and its civil and military officials were taken north under guard, the stores and armament of the commandery fell to the Mongols, and the prefectures around Runing passed under Mongol rule.
cause: 金與蒙古的矛盾起於1211年蒙古破邊之後。1213年金朝自中都南遷汴京，北方大片州縣落入蒙古控制。蒙古並不急於一次滅金，而採取逐次掃蕩、斷其外援、再圖根本的辦法。金朝南遷後曾企圖以與南宋和議換取喘息，並在1214至1220年間趁蒙古內部爭議大舉北伐，收復河東、河北部分失地，卻因糧秣不繼、進展緩慢而作罷。此後宋金為利再啟爭端，蒙古則趁隙南下，1231年拖雷率軍假道宋境、三路大舉，金朝南北兩個戰區同時告急。1232年三路蒙軍合流南下，先破潼關、華山一線，再趨鈞州，金朝在汴京的最後守軍被回回砲與攻城器械困在城內，屢突不出，終以城破。哀宗在汴京失守後不南向宋境求援，也不西據山川固守，而是退入蔡州。選蔡州的理由很清楚：這是金南京留守司的治所，城牆高厚、府庫尚有存儲，城外汝水可以供水，位置又正當南北要衝，蒙古若要南下威脅南宋兩淮，就必須先拔掉它。加上當時蒙古正在裁定汗位、內部諸部爭執，攻蔡的兵力和器械一時難以齊備，蔡州因此被拖成一場曠日持久的圍城。金哀宗也曾遣使向蒙古求糧，得到的回覆是要滅金而並之，議和的門戶遂告關閉。
causeEn: The quarrel between Jin and Mongolia began when the Mongols broke the frontier in 1211. The Jin court moved south from Zhongdu to Bianjing in 1213, and a great stretch of the northern provinces fell into Mongol hands. The Mongols were in no hurry to destroy Jin outright; they worked by clearing one region at a time, cutting Jin from its allies, and only then going to the root. After the move south the Jin had hoped to buy breathing space through a negotiated peace with the Southern Song, and between 1214 and 1220 they used the quarrels inside the Mongol camp to launch a great northern offensive, recovering parts of Hedong and Hebei, but the effort stalled for want of supplies and the slow pace of the advance. The Song and Jin then fell out again over their own interests, and the Mongols took advantage: in 1231 Tolui marched through Song territory with three columns, and the Jin found themselves pressed simultaneously from north and south. In 1232 the three Mongol columns closed on the Central Plain, broke through the Tongguan and Huashan line and drove down to Junchou, where the last Jin defenders were penned inside the city by the Huihui catapults and the siege train, could not break out, and were taken. After Bianjing fell, Aizong neither sought refuge in Song territory nor fortified in the mountains to the west; he withdrew to Caizhou. The choice is easily explained: Caizhou was the seat of the Jin Nanjing Liushou Si, its walls were high and thick, its treasury still held stores, the Ru River ran past the city for water, and it stood astride the north-south road, so that any Mongol drive at the Southern Song's Two Huai had to begin by taking it. At the same time the Mongols were themselves occupied over the succession to the khanship and the disputes among the princes, so that the men and the siege equipment for the attack on Caizhou could not be brought together at once; Caizhou was thus turned into a protracted siege. Aizong also sent emissaries to the Mongols asking for grain, and was told that Jin was to be destroyed and absorbed; the door to negotiation was closed for good.
impact: 蔡州城破標誌金朝覆亡，也把蒙古與南宋之間的緩衝帶一次抹去。此前金朝雖只剩河南數州，尚能替南宋擋住蒙古的騎兵，南宋得以用兩淮、荊襄的縱深從容布置。1234年之後蒙古已無北方牽制，1235年大舉南下，兩淮、襄樊一帶迅速變成主戰場，河南又一次易主，南宋端平入洛的收復成果很快被逆轉。對蒙古本身，佔有河南意味著獲得大片漢地人口、匠戶與糧食來源，漢軍編制由此大規模擴充，蒙古軍隊中漢軍與本部合兵的制度逐步成型，後來的西征與滅宋都依賴這支力量。對金朝宗室而言，是覆滅與北遷：哀宗死於城中，宗室與重臣被押解北方，數十人徒步北上；蔡州的金皇陵在城破後被蒙古軍掘取，陪葬器物大量流失，此後宋陵在楊璡等人主持下遭到同樣的劫掠。對兵器與戰術史而言，這場戰役也留下具體紀錄：蒙古以石砲配重式拋射、雲梯強攻、穴地掘進三種手段並用，被守方的弩箭與投石抵擋，攻防尺度在宋金與蒙古的幾十年戰爭中逐步升級，攻城不再只是撞門挖洞，而是工程兵、砲手與騎兵協同的整套技術。蔡州之後，蒙古把征服方向整個轉向南面，南宋失去北方屏障，只能靠水軍與山城繼續拖延。
impactEn: The fall of Caizhou marked the end of the Jin dynasty and wiped out in a single stroke the buffer between the Mongols and the Southern Song. The Jin, reduced to a few prefectures in Henan, had still been standing in front of the Mongol horse and had given the Song room to arrange its defences in depth along the Two Huai and Jingxiang. After 1234 the Mongols had no northern burden left; they came south in force in 1235, the Two Huai and Xiangyang became the main theatre, Henan changed hands once more, and the recovery the Song attempted in the Duanding era was quickly reversed. For the Mongols themselves, holding Henan meant gaining large numbers of Han people, craftsmen and food, and the Han Chinese military system expanded accordingly; the practice of fighting Mongol and Han troops side by side took shape here, and the later western campaigns and the conquest of the Song both depended on those troops. For the Jin royal house the result was destruction and removal: Aizong died within the city, the household and the senior ministers were marched north, some dozens of them on foot, and the Jin imperial tombs at Caizhou were dug up by the Mongols after the fall, so that a great deal of the funerary treasure was lost; the Song tombs were later looted in the same way under Yang Wanzhi and his associates. For the history of weapons and tactics the battle also leaves a plain record: the Mongols combined three methods, the counterweight shot of the stone catapult, the assault with scaling ladders and the advance by sapping, and these were answered by the defenders with crossbow bolts and thrown stones. The scale of siege and defence grew through the several decades of Song-Jin and Mongol war, and siege warfare was no longer a matter of battering gates and digging holes but of a whole technique in which engineers, artillery crews and cavalry worked together. After Caizhou the Mongols turned the whole of their conquest towards the south, and the Southern Song, stripped of its northern shield, could only go on delaying with its navy and its mountain fortresses.
result: 1233年12月，蒙古軍在砲火掩護下強攻蔡州東面，雲梯登城，守軍節節抵抗到街巷。城破之後，金哀宗把帝位傳給右丞相完顏承麟，寫下絕命書，然後在宮中自焚；承麟在亂軍中即位，當日即死，在位不足一日。忠孝軍統制崔清率殘部死戰至最後，無一降者，蒙古軍逐街肅清殘敵，用了數日才把城內抵抗完全壓下。城破之後，蒙古軍取得蔡州府庫的糧械，點驗俘獲人馬、造冊登記，把俘獲的金朝官員、軍將與宗室北遷，同時招降河南各州縣，汝寧一帶此後數十年改由蒙古的河南江北行省管轄。金朝亡國，南方政權只剩南宋一家，蒙古的統一事業完成第一步。回頭檢視蔡州陷落的原因，輸贏的關鍵在幾個要點：蒙古選擇先斷糧道、再壓城頭、最後才強攻的次序，把守方的時間與糧秣一起耗盡；守方把兵力全押在城牆與糧道上，沒有留下可以反擊的預備隊，糧道一斷，全城再無選擇；蒙古用石砲與穴地同時壓迫城頭，把守軍從城頭逼開的瞬間變成登城的跳板。攻城序列與守城序列的較量，最後由誰能持續供應糧食與器械決定，蔡州給出的答案很明確：攻城方勝。城中的秩序、府庫與陵寢都隨之易主，南北分界線就此北移，蒙古下一個目標只剩下南宋。
resultEn: In December 1233 the Mongol army assaulted the eastern face of Caizhou under cover of the artillery, ladders went up, and the defenders gave ground street by street into the lanes. After the breach Aizong passed the throne to his right chancellor Wanyan Chenglin, wrote his farewell, and set fire to himself in the palace; Chenglin was proclaimed amid the rout and killed the same day, ruling for less than a day. Cui Qing, inspector of the Zhongxiao Army, fought to the last with the remnant of his command and none of them surrendered, and the Mongols cleared the remaining resistance lane by lane, taking several days to finish. The arsenal and stores of the commandery fell to the Mongols, the prisoners were counted and entered on registers, and Jin officials, generals and members of the royal house were taken north; at the same time the various prefectures of Henan were induced to surrender, and the district around Runing was thereafter governed for decades by the Mongol Henan Jiangbei xing sheng. With the Jin gone, only the Southern Song remained among the southern states, and the Mongols took the first step of their unification. Looking back at how Caizhou was lost, the difference turned on a few points: the Mongols chose an order of operations, cut the supply road, crush the parapet, and only then storm, that consumed the defenders' time and food together; the defenders had committed everything to the walls and the granaries and kept no reserve that could strike back, so that once the supply line was cut the whole city had no choice left; and the Mongols pressed the parapet with stone catapults and sapping at the same time, converting the moment when the defenders were driven off the wall into the moment when the ladders went up. The contest between the assault column and the defence was settled in the end by who could keep food and equipment flowing, and Caizhou gave a clear answer: the besiegers won. The order of the city, its treasury and its tombs all changed hands with it, the line between north and south moved up, and the Mongols had only the Southern Song left in front of them.
